title: Shah bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland

tellings.quote: that as amazing, the Shaw bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland in 1970.

plain: In 1970 the Shah, who then ruled Iran, bought technology from Switzerland that uses lasers to enrich nuclear fuel by separating out different forms of uranium. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this without naming a source and calls it amazing, because it would mean Iran got hold of very advanced nuclear methods that early.
